description: This source file defines the BasketService class, which implements the IBasketService interface. It manages shopping basket operations such as adding items, deleting baskets, setting item quantities, and transferring baskets between users in an e-commerce context.

classes.name: BasketService
classes.description: A service class that manages shopping baskets, including adding items, updating quantities, deleting baskets, and transferring baskets between users.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to a user's basket; creates a new basket if one doesn't exist.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes a basket by its ID after checking its existence.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Updates the quantities of items in a basket based on a provided dictionary, and removes empty items.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers basket items from an anonymous basket to a user’s basket, creating one if necessary, then deletes the anonymous basket.
